clauses.clause: Dogs: 1.1× run, ≥ 0.6 s telegraph, ≤ 2 m reach, ≥ 2 s cooldown, 10 HP/bite; low, distinct from the corgi.
clauses.note: Both native tiers:1.1× run speed,36tick/0.6s telegraph,1.08m actual reach,10HP bites and159tick/2.65s hit spacing. Twelve actual physical-input living-dog panels personally inspected across both tiers/zooms show low pale/high wounded quadrupeds clearly distinct from orange backpack corgi; actual windup ground rings. Fifteen-second dog-look yield is an appearance sample, not level completion.
